global_premortem: Reject the one-chapter fallback and verse atomization while preserving the exact whole-letter route.

Do not detach judgment exempla, dreamer accusation and Michael counterexample, Cain/Balaam/Korah triad, metaphor catalogue, Enoch prophecy and application, apostolic remembrance and beloved response, vv22-23 variant cases, or doxology elements.
Do not choose the v5 subject, v12 love-feast/reef wording, vv14-16 citation/source relation, vv22-23 mercy/save/snatch sequence, or vv24-25 doxological readings.

Greek syntax, discourse connectors, punctuation, paragraphing, supplied quotation marks, variant sigla, Strong's-style tags, lemmas, morphology, and roots are evidence only and not automatic boundary or meaning authority.

Do not infer authorship, sibling identity, opponents, 2 Peter dependence, source, angelology, demonology, pseudepigraphal/canonical status, Christology, sexual or other ethics policy, discipline policy, judgment doctrine, doctrine, or theology.
Keep every unit and route LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus.
global_guards: Original-language evidence is evaluated only in phrase, clause, syntax, discourse, catalogue, citation, epistolary, and whole-letter context; isolated roots, glosses, lemmas, morphology, and Strong's-style tags are not authority.
SBLGNT punctuation and variant sigla and WEB headings, paragraphing, punctuation, quotations, and Strong's-style tags are evidence only.
Textual variants trigger case-by-case review; this proposal selects no witness, reading, source tradition, translation, punctuation, or supplied quotation extent.
2 Peter parallels and Enochic/Moses traditions are excluded from this blind local-text primary and cannot decide dependence, source, authorship, canon, or boundaries.
No reading, authorship, opponent, source/dependence, angel/demon, canon, Christology, ethics/discipline, judgment, doctrine, or theology selection is made.
External or human review remains required at convergence; this same-model role does not count as a cross-model independent vote.
